description: Address review findings: fix Lightbox onClose instability via useRef pattern, wrap sentryAdapter test env mutation in try/finally for crash-safety.
steps: Issue 1 - Lightbox onClose instability: Use a useRef to hold onClose so the keyboard useEffect does not depend on it directly. This prevents listener re-registration when the call site passes an unstable inline arrow.
Issue 2 - sentryAdapter test fragile env override: Wrap the import.meta.env.DEV mutation and assertions in a try/finally block so the original value is always restored, even if an assertion throws.
Issue 3 - handleQuit userName closure capture: No fix needed. The useCallback dependency on userName ensures the closure updates when userName changes, which is correct behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Lightbox useEffect for keyboard events does not include onClose in its dependency array
Lightbox uses a ref (onCloseRef) to always call the latest onClose without causing effect re-registration
sentryAdapter test restores import.meta.env.DEV in a finally block
